 Oral Order

2 01-10-2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the complainant and learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner seeks regular bail in the present case registered for the offence under Sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the D.P. Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner is the husband of the victim.
Due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry, petitioner along with co-accused persons are said to have tortured and ousted the complainant from her matrimonial house.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64345 of 2024(2) dt.01-10-2024 petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.
Petitioner is in custody since 29.06.2024.
